coverage_description: Selected public evaluator snapshots: 14 configurations from 11 named labs; not a full global leaderboard or a simultaneous rerun. Submetric coverage is narrower.

cohorts.note: Curated from indexed current primary pages. Full row-level run timestamps, patch-version exports and confidence intervals were unavailable. Freeze these observations; confirm before production publication.

metrics.note: Rounded published index; not a percentage of human intelligence and not a ratio scale.
AutomationBench-AA objective score, not the percentage of fully completed tasks.
Artificial Analysis harness; never merge vendor-run Terminal-Bench scores or v2/v3.
May be negative. Do not clip to zero or relabel this index as accuracy.
Measured long-context benchmark, distinct from advertised context capacity.
Weighted evaluator workload cost; NOT cost per successful real-world task. Not a token list price.
